# YOLOmatic

> Automated computer-vision training CLI/TUI for YOLO26, YOLOv12, YOLO11,
> YOLOv10, YOLOv9, YOLOv8, YOLOX, RF-DETR, SAM 3.1, and Detectron2.

Install (latest release, from GitHub; not on PyPI yet):

```sh
uv tool install --python 3.12 git+https://github.com/shahabahreini/YOLOMatic@v7.0.0
yolomatic
```

Current version: 7.0.0. Python 3.12 or 3.13 on Linux, macOS or Windows.

Full LLM context: [llms-full.txt](https://shahabahreini.github.io/YOLOMatic/llms-full.txt)

Docs: https://shahabahreini.github.io/YOLOMatic/

YOLOmatic is a Python terminal application (interactive TUI plus CLI commands)
for object detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, pose
estimation, and text-prompted (open-vocabulary) segmentation workflows. It supports Ultralytics YOLO model
families, native RF-DETR training, Meta SAM 3.1 inference and fine-tuning, and
Detectron2 training.

## Primary Use Cases

- Generate training YAML configs for YOLO26, YOLOv12, YOLOv11, YOLOv10, YOLOv9, YOLOv8, YOLOX, RF-DETR, SAM 3.1, and Detectron2.
- Fine-tune existing Ultralytics `.pt` checkpoints, RF-DETR `.pth` checkpoints, and SAM 3.1 HuggingFace models on custom datasets.
- Train, validate, export, and monitor computer-vision models through CLI/TUI workflows.
- Run single-image or batch-folder prediction from discovered project weights.
- Run SAM 3.1 open-vocabulary segmentation in auto, text-prompted, or box-prompted modes.
- Benchmark trained checkpoints on COCO validation sets with interactive HTML reports and UMAP vector analysis.
- Augment datasets offline using Albumentations with reusable profiles, split redistribution, and YOLO/COCO output formats.
- Convert Labelbox NDJSON exports into YOLO or COCO formats with concurrent image downloads.
- Merge YOLO-format datasets and preserve class mappings.
- Upload YOLO checkpoints and deploy RF-DETR checkpoints to Roboflow.

## Important Commands

- `yolomatic` — launch the main interactive TUI.
- `yolomatic train --config <file>` — train from a saved config (YOLO, RF-DETR, SAM 3.1, or Detectron2).
- `yolomatic predict --weight <file> --source <path>` — run prediction on an image or folder.
- `yolomatic export --weight <file>` — export to ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, CoreML, TFLite and other formats.
- `yolomatic prepare --source <dir or .ndjson>` — validate, convert and split a dataset.
- `yolomatic upload` / `yolomatic upload-dataset` — upload weights or datasets to Roboflow.
- `yolomatic tensorboard` — launch TensorBoard for discovered runs.
- `yolomatic benchmark`, `yolomatic augment`, `yolomatic convert`, `yolomatic sam` — open that step's interactive wizard.
- `yolomatic --help` — all commands; exit codes 0 success, 1 failure, 2 usage / no terminal, 130 cancelled.
- `uv sync` then `uv run yolomatic` — run from a repository checkout.
- `uv version --bump patch|minor|major` (or `uv version X.Y.Z`) — update the package version.

## Supported Model Families

- RF-DETR detection and segmentation variants: Nano, Small, Medium, Large, XLarge, 2XLarge, plus a preview keypoint/pose model (RFDETRKeypointPreview).
- YOLO26 detection, instance segmentation, semantic segmentation, and pose variants.
- YOLOv12 detection and segmentation variants.
- YOLOv11 detection, segmentation, and pose variants.
- YOLOv10 detection variants.
- YOLOv9 detection and segmentation variants.
- YOLOv8 detection, segmentation, and pose variants.
- YOLOX detection variants.
- SAM 3.1 and SAM 3 open-vocabulary segmentation (HuggingFace, gated model).
- Detectron2 detection and segmentation configs (Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, Mask R-CNN).

## Repository Structure

- `src/yolomatic/cli/` — TUI, prediction, SAM inference, upload, benchmark, augmentation, and TensorBoard launcher commands.
- `src/yolomatic/config/` — config generation and global settings.
- `src/yolomatic/datasets/` — dataset analysis, format detection, conversion, and preparation.
- `src/yolomatic/models/` — model-family metadata for YOLO, RF-DETR, SAM 3.1, and Detectron2.
- `src/yolomatic/trainers/` — YOLO, RF-DETR, SAM 3.1, Detectron2, and shared trainer helpers.
- `src/yolomatic/benchmark/` — benchmark engine, metrics, vector analysis, and interactive HTML report generation.
- `src/yolomatic/augmentation/` — Albumentations offline augmentation engine, profiles, and transforms.
- `src/yolomatic/utils/` — project discovery, TUI rendering, TensorBoard logging, dependency checks, and training preflight logic.

## Current Non-Goals

- YOLO-NAS training is deprecated in this build because SuperGradients conflicts with RF-DETR's modern dependency stack.
- This project does not vendor datasets, trained weights, or generated run artifacts.
- Secrets such as Roboflow API keys belong in `.env`, not YAML configs or documentation.
